leadText: Aya Endō (Japanese: 遠藤綾 Endō Aya) is a Japanese voice actress for .
plainText:
Aya Endō (Japanese: 遠藤綾 Endō Aya) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Endō was born on February 17, 1980, in , , and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. She began her work in the during , where she voiced Veilstone Gym Leader Maylene and character of the day Sally. However, her most prominent role was Alexa in the and series. She also voiced Sinnoh Cynthia for the spin-off series Pokémon Generations. Endō is currently affiliated with the talent agency Office PAC and won both Best Musical Performance and Best Supporting Actress during the of 2008 and the of 2009, respectively.
